newsitem.title: USA: Transact in sales pact with Oki unit.
newsitem.headline: Transact in sales pact with Oki unit.

text.p: TransAct Technologies Inc said Friday it signed an exclusive five-year sales and marketing agreement with Okidata, a division of Oki America Inc, the U.S. unit of Japan's Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd Japan.
Under the agreement, Okidata will market and sell TransAct's point-of-transaction products throughout Latin America and TransAct will supply its products on an as-ordered basis, it said.
Bart Shuldman, TransAct's president and chief executive officer, said preparations for the launch into Latin America are underway.
TransAct makes and sells transaction-based printers and related products that are used to provide transaction records such as receipts, tickets, coupons, register journals and other documents.
